Interface Subject

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractSubject, MatchScoreSubject
public interface Subject
The Subject interface defines methods for attaching, detaching, and notifying observers. Any class that needs to be observed implements this interface.

  • Method Details

    • attach

      void attach(Observer observer)
      Attaches an observer to the subject. Observers will be notified of changes in the subject's state.
      Parameters:
      observer - the observer to attach

    • detach

      void detach(Observer observer)
      Detaches an observer from the subject. The observer will no longer receive updates from the subject.
      Parameters:
      observer - the observer to detach

    • notifyObservers

      void notifyObservers(String message, Object data)
      Notifies all registered observers of a change in the subject's state. Sends a message and optional data to each observer.
      Parameters:
      message - a descriptive message about the update
      data - additional data related to the update
